title: List distinct stops
prompt: Write `uniqueStops(stops: string[]): string[]`. Return each stop name once, in the order it first appears. Keep letter case as is, so `"A"` and `"a"` are different stops. An empty name counts too.
hints: The first time a name appears decides its position.
A `Set` remembers which names you have seen.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Sorts the names instead of keeping first-seen order.

feedback: The first time a name appears decides its position.
